project_name: Bandit - The only band you need
one_line_pitch: ESP32 wristbands for concert attendees that sense crowd density, flash SOS circles on falls, guide exits, auto-process insurance claims and generate post-event recaps, all backed by a SpacetimeDB module.

sponsor_fit_note: Ran the entire live event as one SpacetimeDB Maincloud module: reducers as the only write path (SOS incident, light circle and escalation commit together), scheduled reducers for zone state, SpacetimeAuth and per-caller views for access control.
impact_claims_note: Cites National Safety Council accident statistics for motivation; reports 245 scraped records and demo claim savings figures.

one_line_pitch: AI-behavior benchmark with a live survival simulation and a finance (credit sandbox) desk benchmark, run inside SpacetimeDB, comparing how models follow ethical policies under pressure.
problem_statement: Explaining a rule differs from following it when it costs something; the team wanted visible evidence of whether models obey policies under pressure.
target_user: AI safety/evaluation researchers and model developers
distinctive_notes: Models are called from inside SpacetimeDB via scheduled procedures with HTTP fetch (126 overnight runs, 8 models); also fine-tunes its own LoRA model on DGX Spark and ships an Apify Actor; reports quantitative findings.

tech_items.name: SpacetimeDB (20 Hz tick, scheduled procedures, views, Maincloud)

sponsor_fit_note: Used SpacetimeDB as game server, agent runtime and scorekeeper in one TypeScript module: 30+ tables, reducer-per-action commits with policy-detector records, scheduled procedures calling model providers over HTTP, and a public leaderboard view.
impact_claims_note: Reports own experiment results, e.g. rule-breaking cut from 6.0% to 2.9% across 126 runs and 231 finance cases.

one_line_pitch: Agent-run factory that deploys a robot policy end to end: baselines, diagnoses failures, buys targeted demonstration data from phone-based contributors, fine-tunes pi0.5 and re-evaluates.

one_line_pitch: Multi-agent month-end close for SaaS startups where worker agents only propose, a cross-vendor Red Team critiques, an Advisor rules and the CFO confirms material items before anything posts to the ledger.

impact_claims_note: Cites a ten-day month-end close; reports 156 engine tests and a demo close producing 52 Proposals.

one_line_pitch: Real-time coordination layer that lets AI coding agents on different laptops share intentions via MCP, snapshot unfinished work through Git and resolve integration conflicts with a Factory Droid orchestrator.
